Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns Amid NEET Controversy

Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post following widespread protests and pressure related to the NEET exam paper leak. A BJP leader claimed Pradhan had offered to resign on the first day of student agitation but was asked to wait. The father of a NEET aspirant who died by suicide expressed a wish to see Pradhan's resignation. The NEET exam has been re-conducted, and student protests have concluded.
